Batch 11 of `frontier-38-owner-30` is scaffolded and recorded. Summary:

## What was built

**Pair `peter-weyl-theory-for-general-compact-groups` (510.073/510.074)** — 24 items: **17 on A** (the design's 11 items preserved verbatim + 6 local prerequisites: unitary-dual definition, direct-sum/tensor lemma, convolution commutation/adjoint lemma, Hilbert-direct-sum definition, L¹ functional calculus, finite-dim-subrepresentation lemma) and **7 on B** (the design's 4 examples/counterexample + 3 local lemmas: profinite factorization, product factorization, translation-invariant-modulus lemma).

The design's proof route is preserved: compact convolution (RG-21) → spectral pieces → matrix-coefficient separation → complex Stone–Weierstrass → uniform density → L² orthonormal basis → regular/unitary decomposition → Parseval and countable support. I re-derived the separation argument and corrected one subtle step in its strategy (the contradiction now uses `(ρ(g)−I)L² ⊆ ker C_φ` and `C_φρ(g)=ρ(g)C_φ`, avoiding an unjustified "ψ ∈ range C_ψ" claim).

**Files written:** `batch-11.pages.json`, `batch-11.coverage.json` (37 harvested rows, 4 sources stamped and inspected in full: Kowalski, Vogan, Tao, Teleman), `batch-11.notes.md`, `batch-11.cross-batch-dependencies.json` (4 reviewed edges to the in-run LCA-dual page — the drift-applied obligation), and 24 current `step1-<item>.json` ready records. No published content, shared plans or engine state touched; the unified frontier ledger was refreshed through its tool.

## Recorded decisions / conflicts

- Plan adds `character-groups-and-elementary-lca-duals` to the A requires (design omits it) — plan controls; honored at item level by the circle example.
- The design's third treatment (Colojoară–Gheondea Ch. 3) was **not** recovered in prior runs and is not claimed as read; the pair stands on Kowalski + Vogan (two verified treatments) plus Tao/Teleman support.
- Convention reconciliation recorded for the regular representation's dual factor; no countability of the dual asserted (per drift direction); Parseval/inversion modes stated precisely (no uniform partial-sum claim for arbitrary continuous functions).
